review_body: The parcel arrived early and the product feels sturdy and exactly as described.
I contacted customer support three times for a refund and nobody answered.
The product size is completely wrong and the fabric feels cheap.
The package was delayed but customer service explained the issue and helped me track it.
Everything was smooth and I am happy with the overall experience.
One item was missing from the package and support was slow to respond.
The product is okay overall but nothing special for the price.
Customer service arranged a replacement quickly after I reported the damaged item.
There was no tracking information and the delivery status stayed unclear for days.
The design is beautiful and the material feels premium.
The shipping box was open when it arrived but the product inside was fine.
The support agent was rude and did not answer my question about the return.
